record.name: Inferno Leech
record.description: The user lays a writhing curse on the target that bleeds away their health on each of the next few rounds. Meanwhile part of the damage the user takes is turned into health for a short time.
record.battleDescription: %user lays a writhing curse on %target that bleeds away their health, while the backlash settles over %user as a veil that drinks in incoming blows.

record.name: Dr. Kim's Miracle Potion
record.description: A mysterious brew that briefly prevents debuffs and protects your active effects from being cleared.
record.battleDescription: %user takes a swig from the bottle, quickly downing its contents.

record.name: Parry
record.description:
A precise defensive counter that boosts the user’s bukijutsu damage and reduces the opponent’s offensive output.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
record.battleDescription: %user deflects an incoming blow with masterful control, twisting their stance into a sharp counter. The technique shifts the tide of battle—amplifying their own weapon-based attacks while disrupting %target’s ability to strike with full force.

record.name: Chakra Shield
record.description: The user's chakra automatically forms a shield around them in response to an incoming attack.
record.battleDescription: As %user focuses their chakra, a shimmering barrier forms around them, manifesting as a protective shield. The opponent's attacks are repelled by this formidable barrier, their strikes weakening as they impact the shield. %user stands resolute behind the chakra shield, ready to defend against any assault with unwavering determination.

record.name: Stormblade Arc
record.description: The user carves a spiraling arc of storm-charged steel that slices through the defenses of every enemy in its path. Lightning coils around the user afterwards, throwing part of the damage they take back at the attacker.
record.battleDescription: %user strikes in a flash, slashing through %target with a blade crackling with storm energy. The momentum whirls the blade onward in a spiral as arcs of electricity coil around their form. The blade’s storm-charged edge reflects part of the incoming damage back toward its source.

record.name: Phantom Step
record.description: The user flits across the field like a phantom, landing in near silence. Allies around the landing spot take less damage for a short time, while the user's own attacks hit harder.
record.battleDescription: In the midst of combat, %user channels their chakra into their legs and feet, synchronizing their movements with the surrounding shadows. With a light step, they become nearly invisible to the naked eye, their presence fading like a phantom. The user moves silently and swiftly, weaving through obstacles without making a sound. As %user advances, their form flickers in and out of visibility, making their movements difficult to track. By the time anyone pinpoints %user's position, it's already too late; %user is poised for a counterstrike, and the lingering shadows guard them from harm.

record.name: Ikazuchi Kunai
record.description: A masterfully forged throwing Kunai, its edges arcing with raw electricity. As it soars, jagged lightning leaps from its blade, scorching the air and vanishing as suddenly as a storm’s fury.
record.battleDescription: With a lightning-quick motion, %user hurls the Kunai at %target. The blade tears through the air, trailing jagged arcs of electricity that explode on impact, unleashing a thunderous shock that rends everything in its path.

record.name: Shrapnel Clone Barrage
record.description:
The user sends a wave of clones rushing into the fray, each one bursting into chakra shrapnel on impact. The embedded fragments keep tearing at everyone caught in the blast over the next few rounds.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
record.battleDescription: %user sends a wave of clones charging at %target, and they detonate in a storm of chakra shrapnel that buries itself in everyone nearby.

record.name: Ethereal Rebirth
record.description:
A forbidden art that breaks the seal upon the user's soul and burns them anew in green flame, turning every wound into new life at the cost of their strength.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
record.battleDescription: %user cracks open the seal upon their own soul, and the elements burn through them in a roar of green flame that erupts outward to strike %target. In the fire's wake %user's body begins to unmake and remake itself, turning every wound they suffer into new life. The rebirth is not gentle; it pulls the strength from %user's arms to feed the blaze, and for a time their blows fall soft as ash. What rises from those flames is harder to kill than what entered them.

record.name: Chakra Resonance
record.description: The user releases a harmonic pulse of chakra that crashes into the target. The resonance rattles through their body and can stun them, slowing their next moves.
record.battleDescription: %user sends a resonating wave of chakra crashing into %target, the vibration leaving them reeling.

record.name: Forbidden Chakra Fury
record.description: The user's chakra lashes out aggressively at all nearby enemies. The chakra attacks autonomously, seeking out targets within a certain range. The attacks are fast and powerful, capable of causing significant damage to multiple opponents.
record.battleDescription: With a fierce battle cry, %user channels their chakra into a raging storm of energy, surrounding %target. Each strike fueled by this chakra fury lands with intense force, overwhelming %target's defenses and pushing them to their limits. The sheer ferocity of the assault leaves %target reeling, struggling to withstand the relentless barrage of chakra-infused attacks.

record.name: Aetherion
record.description: A blade made from wind and fire chakra.
record.battleDescription: %user pulls out a blade and releases their dual-nature fire and wind chakra. The elements merge, strengthening the blade. %user then launches the blade at %target, cutting clean through.

requirementItem.name: Heart of Kuraokami
requirementItem.description: Heart of Kuraokami is a legendary herb from Hyorin Village, with pale blue, crystalline petals and frosty, delicate veins that emit a faint, cold glow. It is revered by shinobi for its mystical, icy properties.

requirementItem.name: Solar Bow
requirementItem.description: <b><i>The Solar Bow, forged from redwood and steel, channels immense power to fire bolts with unmatched speed and strength, surpassing any conventional bow in sheer force.
requirementItem.battleDescription: %user uses Solar Bow, shooting %target with great precision

record.name: Dr. Kim Disaster Potion
record.description: A new potion made by Dr. Kim based on Dr. Stein’s research.
record.battleDescription: %user throws a bottle of highly volatile chemicals that explodes into a green mist as the vial breaks. %target is consumed by a poisonous cloud.

record.name: Elite Smoke Bomb
record.description: An upgraded version of the basic smoke bomb.
record.battleDescription: A blast of smoke covers the battlefield, obscuring everyone inside.

record.name: Forgotten Ember Blade
record.description: Forgotten Ember Blade harnesses the fierce and explosive power of the fire element, once thought lost to the Yaketsuku Netsu bloodline. The user channels their chakra into their weapon, transforming it into a conduit for devastating flames. With a powerful swing, they unleash a wave of fiery energy that incinerates everything in its path, leaving nothing but scorched earth in its wake.
record.battleDescription: %user's eyes burn with an intense focus as they channel their chakra into their weapon, flames crackling to life along the blade. With a powerful shout, they swing their weapon in a wide arc, unleashing a torrent of fiery energy towards %target. The ground beneath the slash ignites, and %target is engulfed in a blazing inferno, their form outlined by the searing flames. The heat is overwhelming, and the sheer force of the attack leaves %target reeling, their defenses crumbling under the relentless assault. The air is thick with the scent of smoke and ash, a testament to the destructive might of the Yaketsuku Netsu bloodline.

record.name: Yuki's Frostbite
record.description: A large axe imbued with the chilling abilities of the spirits that roam the Hyuogaan Mountains.
record.battleDescription: With each hit from the axe, %target is slowly covered in frost that seems to grow from the wounds.

requirementItem.name: Solar Petal
requirementItem.description: Solar Petal is a rare desert flower found in the intense sunlight of Shirohana Village.
requirementItem.battleDescription: Solar Petal is a rare desert flower found in the intense sunlight of Shirohana Village.

requirementItem.name: Galecrest Sage
requirementItem.description: A rare material that sells for a high price

requirementItem.name: Veilbreaker's Edge
requirementItem.description: An Axe with a wooden handle but a sharp blade
requirementItem.battleDescription: %user swings the might axe bringing it down on %target 's head

requirementItem.name: Widow's Kiss
requirementItem.description: Widow's Kiss is a rare, shadowy herb from Syndicate, known for its dark, twisting vines and small, sharp thorns with a faint sheen.
requirementItem.battleDescription: Widow's Kiss is a rare, shadowy herb from Syndicate, known for its dark, twisting vines and small, sharp thorns with a faint sheen.

record.name: Colored Jewel of the Dragon's Neck
record.description: A radiant gem that pulsates with mystical energy, shifting colors. It holds the essence of the dragon’s power and is believed to connect the bearer to the spirit realm.
record.battleDescription: %user places the dragon jewel around their neck increasing their offense and defense

record.name: Danse Macabre
record.description: The user conjures a bloom of spectral blades that dance around the target before piercing their chakra points. The wounds can seal away their bloodline for a short time.
record.battleDescription: Spectral blades erupt from %user in a ghostly bloom, scattering around %target before arcing inward to pierce the chakra points that feed their bloodline.

record.name: Chakra Overflow
record.description: A potent chakra buff that surges through every offensive path, making all of the user's attacks hit far harder for a short time.
record.battleDescription: %user channels a surge of chakra beyond their natural limit, their aura expanding in a volatile ripple of power. This overflowing chakra wraps around them in thick, radiant waves, barely restrained. Chakra Overflow heightens every offensive path: physical strikes land harder, ninjutsu hits with greater force, and even genjutsu becomes more potent. The surge floods through %user's body and mind, doubling down on that force for the intensity of high-stakes combat. It is the edge between control and chaos, a moment where %user becomes a living conduit of power.

record.name: Seal of Nullification
record.description: The user binds the target in chains of sealing script that lock their chakra against any new enhancement. The same seals ward the user, shielding them from debuffs for a short time.
record.battleDescription: %user weaves intricate seals in the air, summoning glowing ethereal chains that surge toward %target, coiling tightly to disrupt their chakra flow, suppressing any attempts to invoke new enhancements while the last links settle over %user as a ward against debuffs.

record.name: Subaku Palace
record.description: A forbidden art stolen from Subaku Castle that calls the demon palace into the waking world, sapping every enemy beneath its gates while pouring dark power into its master.
record.battleDescription: %user presses a palm to the earth, and a sigil of burning gold spirals outward across the battlefield. With a sound like grinding stone, gates of red sandstone carved with snarling faces tear free of the ground, and the shadow of the demon palace falls across the field. Beneath those gates strength drains away and every strike grows timid, while the palace pours its dark power into the one who summoned it. For a time the battlefield belongs to the demon palace, and to its master.

record.name: Severed Pulse
record.description: The user slices a wave of chakra through the target's pulse, cutting off the flow that mends their body. For a short while their healing falters and non-elemental attacks strike them harder.
record.battleDescription: %user releases a cutting wave of chakra that severs the natural flow of recovery within %target. The disruption corrodes regenerative functions and breaks down their guard, amplifying the effect of incoming non-elemental attacks.

record.name: Night's Testament
record.description: “When the sun bears witness, this blade sleeps. When night falls, it remembers.”  Night’s Testament is not forged for war, but for judgment. Its edge is blackened not by fire, but by vows — each strike binding the wielder to the truth of what they’ve done. The markings along the blade are not decoration; they are testaments, etched as memories of every oath fulfilled and every silence kept.  In Seichi, it is said that:  the blade grows heavier with lies,  lighter with resolve,  and will not draw blood unless the wielder’s intent is absolute.  Those who survive its cut remember nothing. Those who fall become part of it.
record.battleDescription: %user holds a blade as dark as night. With one swift movement, too quick for the naked eye, the blade pierces through %target.

requirementItem.name: Soul Harvester
requirementItem.description: <b><i>A pitch-black axe with a pale blue tinge, it sucks the life out of any living thing it comes in contact with. It's said that if you listen closely, you can still hear the screams of those trapped inside...
requirementItem.battleDescription: %user uses Soul Harvester to take down %target

record.name: Eclipse Drain
record.description:
A cursed enhancement that boosts the user's damage and restores health with every strike.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
record.battleDescription: %user draws in a slow breath as a shadow-like chakra coils around their arms and chest, pulsing with violent rhythm. Their strikes begin to land harder, the weight of each hit intensified by dark energy. As they attack, part of the damage inflicted siphons back into their body, restoring vitality through every blow.

record.name: Thunder’s Judgement
record.description: The user wraps themselves in reactive lightning that answers every blow with judgment. For a short while their attacks strike harder and part of every hit they take is thrown back at the attacker.
record.battleDescription: %user surrounds themselves with surging lightning chakra, strengthening their attacks. While the current remains active, incoming damage is partially reflected back at the attacker through reactive lightning.

record.name: Panacea
record.description: A small pill radiating with energy. Its hard for any one person to metabolize the abundance of energy.
record.battleDescription: %user quickly crushes the small ball in their mouth releasing a burst of flavor and energy through their body. They seem to glow with vigor.

record.name: Chakra Pill
record.description: A pill made from 1,000-year-old ginseng.
record.battleDescription: %user quickly bites into the pill, releasing all the chakra stored within it and gaining a significant boost in strength.

record.name: Bloodthorn Kunai
record.description: A throwing Kunai forged from bloodcore-tempered mithril, its edge stained a deep crimson that never dries. Wounds carved by its blade refuse to close, weeping long after the strike has landed.
record.battleDescription: With a sharp motion, %user flings the Blood Kunai toward %target. The crimson blade bites deep, leaving a ragged wound that continues to bleed.

requirementItem.name: Bloodflower
requirementItem.description: A rare crimson bloom that flourishes only in soil steeped in old battlefields. Its petals stay wet to the touch, as if freshly cut, and it is prized by weaponsmiths for bindings that never let a wound close.

requirementItem.name: Bloodcore Ore
requirementItem.description: Found only in the War Torn sector, the minerals soaked in blood over the years have been harden and to form a crystal made of blood

record.name: Eight Fist Style: Lotus Dance
record.description: The user drops into a low, still stance before detonating into eight rapid strikes in perfect rhythm, each landing with surgical precision. The relentless barrage shatters the target's guard and seals them off from any buffs for a moment.
record.battleDescription: %user's stance drops low, tense and almost still, then detonates. With masterful precision and tempestuous speed, they unleash eight rapid, deliberate strikes in perfect rhythm. Each blow strikes with surgical accuracy, shattering %target's guard and sending their balance crumbling under the relentless cadence, their body sealed off from any empowering chakra.

record.name: Void Pulse Barrage
record.description: A barrage of void pulses erupts from the ground, piercing the enemy and making them take more damage.
record.battleDescription: %user drives void chakra beneath the battlefield and a barrage of pulses erupts upward, tearing through every enemy's guard and leaving them exposed.

record.name: Divine Pulse
record.description: A radiant energy pulse that boosts power and weakens the enemy.
record.battleDescription: %user releases a surge of divine energy, enhancing their strength while diminishing %target’s attack power.

record.name: Eternity Flux
record.description: Eternity Flux is a precision-based sand jutsu that weaponizes a single, endless instant.
record.battleDescription: %user draws sand into a tight, orbiting ring around their arm, compressing it until the grains vibrate with unstable chronal energy. With a sharp forward motion, the sand is released in a linear burst, striking the %target

record.name: Chakra Invigoration
record.description: The user surges across the field in a burst of chakra-charged speed. The rush floods their body with energy, so for a short time they hit harder and take less damage.
record.battleDescription: %user surges forward in a burst of chakra-enhanced motion, leaving afterimages as they reposition across the battlefield. As their body moves, internal chakra flow heightens, enhancing physical and mental performance all at once.

record.name: Cellular Regeneration
record.description: The caster cast a barrier around themselves using time to heal their wounds
record.battleDescription: %user draws sand into a slow, circular flow around their body, forming a protective barrier and healing their injuries

record.name: Timelapse
record.description: Timelapse is a high-level temporal sand jutsu that manipulates the perception and flow of time within a confined area.
record.battleDescription: %user slams their hand to the ground, releasing a spiraling formation of fine, golden sand that coils upward like an inverted hourglass. The sand rotates in slow, deliberate motion, suspended in the air slowing %targets attack

record.name: Eternal Darkness
record.description: The user shrouds the target in a veil of darkness, blinding them so their attacks lose force. Hidden in the gloom, the user also takes less damage for a short while.
record.battleDescription: %user weaves a string of hand seals, and a veil of darkness swallows %target, hiding %user from their sight.

record.name: Chakra Resistance
record.description: The user layers dense chakra through their body, hardening it against harm. For a short time they take less damage and their attacks strike with greater force.
record.battleDescription: %user draws chakra inward until it settles over their body like armor, steeling them to endure and to strike back harder.

record.name: Tempered Shūren no Yaiba
record.description: Earned by completing Relic: Tempered Shūren no Yaiba
record.battleDescription: %user holds a blade wrapped in chakra, with one swift movement, naked to the eye, the blade pierces through %target

record.name: Momentum Shift
record.description: Momentum Shift is a devastating control-oriented time jutsu that attacks the concept of motion itself.
record.battleDescription: As %target moves  %user snaps their hand forward, releasing a burst of tightly compressed sand infused with chakra. The sand collides with the %target’s halting their movement

record.name: Timeshift
record.description: Timeshift is an aggressive counterpart to Timelapse, embodying the destructive side of time rather than its restraint.
record.battleDescription: %user snaps their hands together, compressing sand infused with volatile temporal chakra before hurling it toward %target. Upon impact, the sand erupts into a fractured hourglass formation around the enemy, spinning violently as if time itself has been forced to accelerate

record.name: Harmonious Slash
